Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

If Set's Curse is successful on a Mummy like Kherebutu;
Does the effect of the Mummy that shuffles it onto its owner`s library affects Set's Curse resolution? Just to be sure that the ally is created by Set's Curse even if that action tried to burn a Mummy.

A Mummy like Kherebutu becomes Red List.
if the Mummy is burnt by D-Action or combat, is it possible to get any Trophies or the effect of the Mummy that shuffles it onto its owner`s library does not allow that?
I mean does burning a Mummy count as Burning a minion even if it is shuffled to its owner library?

Card Text :
Name: Kherebutu AKA: Kherebutu (Bane Mummy)
Cardtype: Ally
{If he is burned, shuffle him in {his owner's} library.}

Name: Set's Curse
Cardtype: Action
[ser]  Burn any ally or retainer to put this card into play. This card becomes an animal ally with 3 life, 2 strength and 0 bleed. This ally cannot have or use equipment or retainers and cannot play action cards.
[SER] As above, but burn a vampire with capacity less than 3 to put this card in play.

Thanks in advance,
Regards,
Rémi.

Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body:
These resolve just like you would expect. I can’t see any ambiguity.
Mummy is burned, shuffled into library, curse is put in play as an ally.
